iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear file remains critical: IAEA-linked reporting says Kazakhstan is willing to hold Iran enriched uranium if a deal is reached, while Reuters highlights Tehran highly enriched uranium as its strongest negotiating card and deal requirements remain contested. Declared 60 percent enrichment remains the standing technical risk; no verified higher-level jump or device event surfaced.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: US-Iran/Gulf risk remains imminent but eased from peak: BBC reported Trump weighing a final determination on an Iran deal and PBS/CNBC highlighted ceasefire or truce optimism, while other feeds described UAE strikes, sanctions on Iranian oil trade, burning oil infrastructure, vessel attacks, and continuing Strait of Hormuz restrictions.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon risk rose again: Al Jazeera reported Israeli attacks killed 14 in Lebanon, CBC and other feeds reported Israeli forces crossing the Litani/key river in an expanded ground offensive, and security talks have not stopped strikes. Ground expansion and truce-break conditions dominate the next-24h risk.

turkey.name: TURKEY / EAST MED
turkey.notes: Turkey/East Mediterranean remains below escalation threshold: fresh Turkey searches found analysis of Ankara limited role in the Iran war, Eastern Mediterranean posture commentary, and a Turkish-owned ship hit in the Black Sea context, but no fresh direct interstate clash, weapons demonstration, official atomic warning, or mobilization surge.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan moved toward the top of elevated: IISS/twin-front readiness reporting continued and India army chief rhetoric referenced readiness for Operation Sindoor 2.0. No fresh cross-border strike surfaced, but military posture and rhetoric are sharper than yesterday.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO direct-confrontation risk remains imminent: Reuters/BBC/Al Jazeera reported a Russian drone hit a Romanian apartment block, Romania considered NATO Article 4, and NATO/EU condemned Moscow; strategic Oreshnik/nuclear-intimidation commentary remains active. No direct NATO-Russia kinetic exchange confirmed.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China/Taiwan remains elevated but below critical: fresh and recent feeds showed doctrine analysis, pressure beyond the Taiwan Strait, and prior coast-guard standoff coverage near Taiwan-controlled islands, but no blockade, live-fire surge, or crisis-level Taiwan Strait trigger in the current scan.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea remains critical: South Korea reported an unidentified projectile, multiple feeds reported North Korean missile firing and new missile/artillery systems, and sanctions-breaching vessel activity drew renewed allied attention. No device event reported.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine/NATO spillover remains the top escalation driver: Reuters, BBC, Al Jazeera, WION and others reported or amplified the Russian drone hit in Romania, NATO/EU condemnation, and Romanian Article 4 consideration. Putin escalation signaling and nuclear-intimidation commentary remain active.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan climbed inside critical: News On AIR cited Afghan claims that Taliban forces killed 30 Pakistani soldiers along the Durand Line, Khaama Press reported Pakistan pushing war deeper into Afghanistan, and displacement/strike reporting persisted. Rubio talks and regional diplomacy exist but do not offset force-use risk.

sudan.name: SUDAN / RED SEA SPILLOVER
sudan.notes: Sudan/Red Sea spillover carries forward at critical-low: no stronger fresh hard-conflict trigger was found in this scheduled scan, but external-backing and force-posture risks remain active from prior assessment.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE / GAZA
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza risk remains imminent by carry-forward: expanded-control and strike reporting from the prior scan remains the active driver, with weak political off-ramp and continuing force-use risk.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated by residual instability; no fresh clash trigger was found in this scheduled scan.
